description: Frosty the Snowman has a simple, friendly shape made from three rounded snowballs stacked on top of one another: a wide base, a smaller middle, and a round head. His body is slightly lumpy and uneven, as though it was packed by hand from soft snow. Thin stick arms extend from his sides, and his face is broad and cheerful, with dark coal eyes, a smiling coal mouth, and a long carrot nose pointing outward. A tall black top hat sits on his head, giving his otherwise soft, rounded silhouette a distinctive, playful outline.
